title: Basic properties of kappa classes
summary: We define kappa classes on KSBA moduli stacks as classes in operational Chow cohomology. They generalize the Miller-Morita-Mumford classes on the moduli spaces of curves. We prove base-change compatibility, product and normalization formulas, and crepant functoriality, together with the vanishing of all kappa polynomials above the variation. The higher kappa classes are nonnegative on effective cycles, and the largest index of a numerically nontrivial kappa class equals the normalized variation, while the first kappa class detects the total variation.
